links.outcome: Retrospective local validation of AI CXR triage on hospital data versus reference standard
links.effect: Weighted ensemble: accuracy 0.854, sensitivity 0.845, specificity 0.861, AUROC 0.927 on 1045 CXRs from a hospital not used for training.
links.quote: The weighted ensemble demonstrated the best balance, with an accuracy of 0.854 (95% CI, 0.831-0.874), a sensitivity of 0.845 (0.810-0.875), a specificity of 0.861 (0.830-0.887), and an AUROC of 0.927 (0.911-0.940).

links.outcome: Comparison of ensemble decision thresholds/strategies and their sensitivity-specificity tradeoffs
links.effect: Four ensemble strategies compared; sensitivity-prioritized methods reached sensitivity >0.92 but specificity <0.69, while the weighted ensemble gave the best balance.
links.quote: Sensitivity-prioritized methods achieving sensitivity >0.92 produced lower specificity (<0.69).

screen.reason: This study is an external validation of a commercial AI chest X-ray triage algorithm using retrospective hospital data, with an LLM used for automated ground-truth extraction from radiology reports. It evaluates model accuracy metrics without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
